facts.text: On the Belmont University Architecture Studio 3 team whose parklet design "Symphony of the Senses" won at Nashville PARKing Day in Germantown on September 21, 2025, serving on the original design team and the documentation group

note: PM run (second of the day under the new twice-daily cadence). Checked 25, filed 1 (Rosie Hoover). The batch was the last 7 never-checked profiles plus 18 from the oldest (2026-10-26) tier; most profiles were thin single-anchor shells or already current from the Oct 26 full sweep, so the 2-anchor gate rejected nearly everything. Hoover's filing is an expansion: the PARKing Day win was already on file via Merit Pages; Belmont's own story adds the design name, her design-team and documentation-group roles, and a new source (corroborated by the Civic Design Center). Fresh sweep: none found — date-verified in-window items (Oct 14 Health Hero awards, Oct 20 SLU Metcalf obituary, Oct 27 NCPR NY-21 profile) were about people who are not directory members, and the directory members in current coverage (Zvi Szafran's Midtown Plaza item, Ben Hull's legislature resignation) were already on their profiles. Held, not filed: Sarah Diederich (Lisbon music teacher / SUNY Potsdam alumna cannot be tied to the CFA/CFC theater profile) and Hudson Brown (North Country Savings Bank banker page carries only one profile anchor) — both need JD's word on identity.

fresh.note: Sweep of North Country Now, NCPR, NNY360, WWNY, ClickNNY, Clarkson/SLU/SUNY Potsdam/SUNY Canton news and athletics, honors and health-system news for 2026-10-07 to 2026-10-28 found no new, not-already-filed item about a confirmed directory member; in-window items were about non-directory people, and directory members in coverage (Zvi Szafran, Ben Hull) had their facts already on file.
